newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Lee on four-nation European visit.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Lee on four-nation European visit.

text.p: Singapore's Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew begins a four-nation European visit on Friday, a Singapore government statement said.

The statement, issued late on Thursday, said Lee, Singapore's prime minister from 1959 to 1990, will be in France from May 30 until June 5, in the Netherlands between June 5-7, in the United Kingdom from June 7-12 and in Germany between June 12-13.
Lee is on a private visit and his schedule includes calls on French President Jacques Chirac and British Prime Minister Tony Blair as well as attending business forums.
